groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Official 2026 Washakie clerk retentions for Justice Bridget Hill (YES 1,977 / NO 440), Justice Robert C. Jarosh (YES 1,944 / NO 470), and Chancery Judge Ben Burningham (YES 1,979 / NO 413) are those statewide retentions. Local rows are 5th Judicial District judges (Park, Big Horn, Hot Springs, and Washakie). Full names and term dates follow official Wyoming Judicial Branch 5th JD pages and the official March 2026 roster already used in the Park history. Official Washakie named retentions are cited (2024 Bill Simpson YES 2,817 / NO 493, S. Joseph Joey Darrah YES 2,750 / NO 507, Edward G. Luhm YES 2,911 / NO 529; 2026 Bobbi Overfield YES 2,038 / NO 479).
